title: GTM Hiring Signal Scraper
description: Input configuration for GTM Hiring Signal Scraper. Free Apify-plan users get 60 results per calendar month (resets monthly); upgrade for unlimited: https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=mamba

domain.title: Company Domain
domain.description: Bare domain without https:// or trailing slash. Example: stripe.com

role_filter.title: Role Filter Keywords
role_filter.description: Optional array of GTM role keywords to filter on. Defaults to built-in GTM_KEYWORDS list if omitted.

ats_slug.title: ATS Slug Override
ats_slug.description: Optional override for the ATS board slug when it differs from the domain (e.g. clay.com uses claylabs on Ashby). If omitted, the scraper auto-probes common slug variants.

domains.title: Company Domains (batch)
domains.description: List of bare domains to process when mode is "batch". Each entry without https:// or trailing slash. Example: stripe.com

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Processing mode. "single" scores the domain field; "batch" scores every entry in the domains list; "velocity" compares this run against the previous_* values to detect role changes.

include_role_details.title: Include Role Details
include_role_details.description: When true, include the full per-role detail array (title, department, location, url) in the output.

previous_gtm_role_count.title: Previous GTM Role Count
previous_gtm_role_count.description: GTM role count from the previous run for this domain, used in velocity mode to compute the delta.

previous_run_date.title: Previous Run Date
previous_run_date.description: ISO date of the previous run for this domain, used in velocity mode to report days between runs.

source_tag.title: Source Tag
source_tag.description: Internal attribution tag set by Mamba Labs on published task examples. Not required, and nothing depends on it. Leave it empty.
